Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies

Ingredients:
2 1/4 cups flour
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon baking soda
1 cup butter, softened
1/2 cup white sugar
1 cup packed brown sugar
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
2 large eggs
2 cups semisweet chocolate chips

Instructions:
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
In a medium-sized bowl, whisk together flour, salt, and baking soda.
In a large mixing bowl, cream together butter and sugars.
Beat in vanilla and eggs.
Slowly mix in the flour mixture.
Stir in the chocolate chips.
Drop by the spoonful onto a baking sheet.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown.

Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies

Ingredients:
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon baking soda
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 cup packed light-brown sugar
1/2 cup granulated sugar
1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
1 large egg
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt.
3. In another bowl, beat the brown sugar, granulated sugar, and butter together with a mixer until creamy.
4. Add the egg and vanilla to the butter mixture and beat until combined.
5. Gradually add the flour mixture to the butter mixture, beating until just combined.
6. Stir in the chocolate chips.
7. Drop the dough by tablespoonfuls onto the prepared baking sheets.
8. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the edges are golden brown. Let cool on the baking sheet for 2 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies

Ingredients
1 1/2 cups flour
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 cup butter
1 1/2 cups sugar
1 egg
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
1 1/2 cups chocolate chips

Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease cookie sheets or line with parchment paper.
2. Sift together the flour, baking soda, and salt; set aside.
3. In a large bowl, cream together the butter and sugar until smooth. Beat in egg and vanilla. Gradually blend in the dry ingredients. Stir in the chocolate chips by hand.
4. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto the prepared cookie sheets. Cookies should be about 2 inches apart.
5. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies

Ingredients
1/2 cup unsalted butter, room temperature
1/2 cup packed light-brown sugar
1/4 cup granulated sugar
1 large egg, room temperature
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon baking soda
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 1/2 cups semisweet chocolate chips (about 9 oz)

Instructions
Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper; set aside. In a large bowl, cream together butter and sugars with an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Add egg and vanilla, mixing well. Stir together flour, baking soda, and salt; add to butter mixture, mixing until just combined. Stir in chocolate chips. Roll dough into 1-inch balls and place on prepared baking sheet, spacing 2 inches apart. Bake until edges are golden, 11 to 13 minutes. Let cool on baking sheet 5 minutes; transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies

You will need the following ingredients:
- 1 cup of unsalted butter
- 1 cup of granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup of brown sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 2 teaspoons of vanilla extract
- 2 1/4 cups of all-purpose flour
- 1 teaspoon of baking soda
- 1/2 teaspoon of salt
- 2 cups of semi-sweet chocolate chips
- 1 cup of pecans or walnuts, optional

Steps you will take to prepare them:
1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large mixing bowl, cream together the butter and sugars until light and fluffy. This usually takes about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Then, stir in the vanilla extract.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
5. Stir in the chocolate chips and nuts (if using) until evenly distributed.
6. Using a spoon or cookie scoop, drop the dough onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
7. Bake the cookies in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden brown. The centers will still look soft, but they will set as they cool.
8. Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
9. Enjoy your chewy chocolate chip cookies!
